en: The image is a black and white photograph of a picturesque landscape dominated by two bridges crossing over a river. The upper structure is a large stone viaduct with multiple tall arches, while the lower bridge is shorter and also arched. There are several houses and a church visible near the base of the bridges, and the foreground features a body of water and grassy land. The text in the lower left corner reads 'Göhrener Brücke.'
